name: MatBoardFrame
job: Frame a featured product, dish or artwork with a bevel-cut picture-framing mat and a small gallery plaque holding its name and price
visitor_action: hover the piece or tap the plaque to lift it and reveal a longer note; Enter or Space on the focused plaque toggles it
owner_settings: Image (or text shown when there is no image)
mobile: thinner mat and frame, plaque sits beneath the frame
motion: wall shadow, picture-light glow, glass reflection and bevel highlight shift with scroll on a spring; plaque lifts and the note slides open on hover or tap (reduced-motion: static frame with the note always visible)
art_direction: Gallery oak: warm oak frame, oatmeal mat with crisp cut bevel, brass plaque with engraved black text, soft wall shadow
